Sally is writing a program for a game, which is about guessing letters in the word given by the computer. She needs to read a text file called “dictionary.txt” in the program for choosing a random word from the following list.
hospital
orange
obsidian
dragon
water

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Complete the following sub-program getWords() in Python to save the words in “dictionary.txt” as a list wordlist.(2 marks)
wordlist = []
def getWords():
global wordlist
f = open(___________________, ___)
word = f.readline()
while ____________________:
word = word.replace("\n", "")
wordlist = wordlist + [word]
word = f.readline()
f.close()

parts.label: b
parts.text:
All the words have been stored in list wordlist. Given that the function randint(a, b) in the random library returns a random integer from a to b. Complete the following Python program to draw a word from the list and save it in a variable w.(2 marks)
import random

parts.label: c
parts.text:
The word for guessing will be converted to a string of asterisks of the same length, and this string will be printed when the game starts. For example, if the word for guessing (w) is “water”, the following is displayed at the beginning of the game:
The word for guessing: *****
Complete the following Python program to hide the letters in the word for guessing and print the converted string.(2 marks)
hidden = ""
print("The word for guessing: ", hidden)

parts.label: d
parts.text:
